chunks: There is no one comparable to Him.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that there is no one comparable to God in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as the culmination of divine negation (Salb), affirming that God’s essence is free from any form of partnership or likeness, a concept central to the doctrine of Tawhid al-Dhat. It serves as a definitive rebuttal to anthropomorphism and polytheism, establishing that no created being can share in His unique attributes or actions. This absolute incomparability underscores the purity of monotheism required for sincere worship.
